extension_description.message: Capture the complete scrollable area of the active page as a local PNG.

popup_intro.message: Automatically scrolls the active tab, stitches it, and downloads a PNG.

privacy_note.message: Images are processed locally and never uploaded.

capture_idle_message.message: Ready to capture the current page.

error_background_unreachable.message: Could not reach the extension's background process. Please close and reopen this panel.

error_start_capture.message: Could not start the capture. Reload the page and try again.

error_start_region.message: Could not start region selection. Reload the page and try again.

error_no_active_tab.message: No capturable active tab was found.

error_unsupported_page.message: Firefox does not allow capturing this page; please use a regular website tab.

error_restricted_page.message: For security reasons, Firefox blocks all extensions on official domains such as addons.mozilla.org; please use a regular website tab.

error_content_script_unavailable.message: Could not read the current page; reload a regular website and try again.

error_tab_not_active.message: The tab was switched during capture. Keep the target tab in the foreground and try again.

error_page_size_changed.message: The page kept changing size during capture, so it was stopped to avoid cropping.

error_scroll_position_mismatch.message: The page prevented precise scrolling, so the capture was stopped to avoid blank areas.

error_scroll_target_not_fully_visible.message: The scrollable region is not fully visible in the viewport (it must be smaller than the viewport and fully visible), so the capture was stopped to avoid missing content.

error_region_target_invalid.message: The selected scrollable region is no longer valid (removed or no longer scrollable); please pick it again.

error_canvas_dimension_exceeded.message: The page is too long or too wide and exceeds Firefox's safe image dimensions.

error_canvas_area_exceeded.message: The page has too many pixels, so the capture was stopped to keep the browser from running out of memory.

error_too_many_segments.message: The page needs too many capture segments, so it was stopped to avoid occupying the browser for too long.

error_capture_already_active.message: This tab is already being captured.

error_download_failed.message: The image was created, but Firefox could not start the download.

error_cleanup_failed.message: The page state could not be fully restored; please reload this tab.

error_segment_scroll_lost.message: The page scrolled or updated itself during capture and stayed unstable after retries, so the capture was stopped to avoid misaligned stitching; please try again.

error_capture_failed.message: Capture failed. Reload the page and try again.

diag_scroll_mismatch.message: Diagnostics: $1, requested ($2, $3), actual ($4, $5), max ($6, $7), $8 attempt(s), target $9.
diag_scroll_mismatch.description: $1 scroll mode; $2/$3 requested x/y; $4/$5 actual x/y; $6/$7 max x/y; $8 attempts; $9 connection state

diag_page_size_document.description: $1..$4 document width/height before → after; $5..$8 viewport width/height before → after

diag_page_size_frame.description: $1..$4 region frame x, y, width × height before; $5..$8 after

capture_success_saved.description: $1 capture noun (full page or region capture)

capture_success_scaled.message: $1 was scaled to $2 × $3 pixels and saved.
capture_success_scaled.description: $1 capture noun; $2 final width; $3 final height

picker_prompt.message: Click the scrollable region you want to capture; press Esc to cancel.

popup_open_editor_hint.message: Click the thumbnail to annotate the image in the editor.

popup_editor_unavailable.message: No captured image to edit; please take a capture first.

editor_load_failed.message: Could not load the capture; please capture again from the tab.

editor_text_hint.message: Click the image to place text; click existing text to select or drag it, double-click to edit its content and style, Delete to remove. The box width sets the wrapping; drag its corner to resize.

editor_hint.message: Pick a tool and drag on the image; for text, click where it should start.
